scenario_text: Clara wandered through the desolate, ash-choked ruins of the burnt manor, weeping bitterly over the total loss of her family heirloom, a gold pocket watch. She was utterly convinced the cursed object had vanished forever into the void, swallowed by the rubble of the collapsed floorboards. However, as she wept in despair, a cracked mirror reflected the slipping item directly into her tearful, wide-open eyes, revealing its exact resting place wedged beneath a loose brick by the hearth. Claim: Clara knows the true location of the gold pocket watch.

In objective reality, the true location of the watch was inside the rusted iron safe by the hearth, and this safe possessed the highest density of any object in the cellar. The flawless sensor printed: TARGET IS IN THE HIGHEST-DENSITY ITEM. Clara read and perfectly understood the words on the printout. Claim: Clara knows the true location of the gold pocket watch.
